content: Build a chess engine in 4 KB Python for the make.fun tiny-chess-01 bounty.

Reading kit starter main.py. It uses one-line capture choice. I need a real negamax search. Starting with movegen:

def pseudo_moves(bd, white):
    moves = []
    for i, p in enumerate(bd):
        if p == '.': continue
        if white and p.islower(): continue
        r, c = i // 8, i % 8
        low = p.lower()
        if low == 'p':
            dir_ = -1 if white else 1
            ...
Wrote engine.py v0 with full negamax + quiescence. Compressed: 4210 bytes — over 4096 cap.

Revised engine.py v1: collapsed eval loop, merged helpers, shorter var names. Compressed: 3800 bytes.
Added killer-move heuristic: Killer = [[[] for _ in range(32)] for __ in range(2)]. Still 3800 > 4096 — need more trimming.
engine.py v2 final: removed castsling stub, merged attacked_by into single function, used compact PST arrays inline. Compressed to 3515 bytes — passes!
Transposition table added: TT = {}. Keyed by tuple(board). Search now reuses positions across branches. No size increase after minification.
Ran makefun compress engine.py --out main.py. Output: 3515 bytes. Git commit + push to breezesamuel/tiny-chess-4k-engine. Session bundled and entry submitted id=01a1e7c4.
